'''Solence''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he served as an [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Solence was killed when a Republic strike team was [[Korriban Incursion|sent to secure]] Sith [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] on Korriban.<ref name="Incursion">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Korriban Incursion: Republic}}</ref>
